017package org.apache.juneau.http.classic.response;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.http.classic.response.NoContent.*;
021
022import org.apache.http.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.commons.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.http.classic.*;
026
027/**
028 * Represents an <c>HTTP 204 No Content</c> response.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * The server successfully processed the request and is not returning any content.
032 *
033 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
034 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauRestCommon">juneau-rest-common Basics</a>
035 * </ul>
036 */
037@Response
038@StatusCode(STATUS_CODE)
039@Schema(description = REASON_PHRASE)
040public class NoContent extends BasicHttpResponse<NoContent> {
041
042   /** HTTP status code */
043   public static final int STATUS_CODE = 204;
044
045   /** Reason phrase */
046   public static final String REASON_PHRASE = "No Content";
047
048   /** Default status line */
049   private static final BasicStatusLine STATUS_LINE = BasicStatusLine.create(STATUS_CODE, REASON_PHRASE);
050
051   /** Default unmodifiable instance */
052   public static final NoContent INSTANCE = new NoContent().unmodifiable();
053
054   /**
055    * Constructor.
056    */
057   public NoContent() {
058      super(STATUS_LINE);
059   }
060
061   /**
062    * Constructor.
063    *
064    * <p>
065    * This is the constructor used when parsing an HTTP response.
066    *
067    * @param response The HTTP response to copy from.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
068    * @throws AssertionError If HTTP response status code does not match what was expected.
069    */
070   public NoContent(HttpResponse response) {
071      super(response);
072      assertStatusCode(response);
073   }
074
075   /**
076    * Copy constructor.
077    *
078    * @param copyFrom The bean to copy from.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
079    */
080   public NoContent(NoContent copyFrom) {
081      super(copyFrom);
082   }
083
084   /**
085    * Creates a builder for this class initialized with the contents of this bean.
086    *
087    * @return A new builder bean.
088    */
089   public NoContent copy() {
090      return new NoContent(this);
091   }
092
093   @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpResponse */
094   public NoContent unmodifiable() {
095      return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean ? this : new Unmodifiable(this);
096   }
097
098   /**
099    * Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing {@link NoContent} response.
100    *
101    * <p>
102    * Its only behavioral override is {@link #modify(Runnable)}, which throws — because all mutation is funneled through
103    * {@code modify(...)}, this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.
104    */
105   public static class Unmodifiable extends NoContent implements UnmodifiableBean {
106
107      /**
108       * Constructor.
109       *
110       * @param copyFrom The response to snapshot.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
111       */
112      @SuppressWarnings({
113         "java:S1699" // Paradigm intentionally calls the overridable freeze() from the ctor to deep-freeze sub-beans.
114      })
115      protected Unmodifiable(NoContent copyFrom) {
116         super(copyFrom);
117         freeze();
118      }
119
120      @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpResponse */
121      protected NoContent modify(Runnable mutation) {
122         throw uoex("Bean is unmodifiable.");
123      }
124   }
125}
